_doc: Single source of parameters for the PROPOSED designs (tools/design_*.py read this file). Every value has a 'basis': VERIFIED = from a repository file, DATASHEET = from a datasheet in 7_Components Datasheets, DECISION = design decision D-xx logged in 00_DESIGN_BASIS.md, ASSUMPTION = to be confirmed.

scan_axis.value: elevation (16 rows stacked vertically); azimuth by mechanical rotation
scan_axis.basis: VERIFIED main.cpp n=31 elevations, y=50 azimuths

substrate.basis: DECISION D-04 (RO4350B datasheet present in repo; 0.508 mm = standard 20 mil, matches PCBWay impedance note family)

component_height_top_mm.basis: ASSUMPTION D-07: SMA edge/vertical connectors and Molex headers; to be measured

board_pitch_mm.basis: DECISION D-07 (15 + 4 + 1.6 + margin, rounded to standard 25 mm standoffs)

material.value: aluminium sheet, folded + riveted/welded, powder-coated; IP54 target

tim_r_c_per_w.basis: ASSUMPTION thermal pad/grease per PA footprint

drive.value: direct drive: stepper shaft -> 1:1 timing belt -> turntable (keeps 4 steps per 7.2 deg azimuth)
drive.basis: DECISION D-12 (firmware uses Stepper_steps/y_max = 4 steps per position)

stepper.basis: DECISION D-12; driver TB6600 per xlsx row 63 (9-42 V, 4 A)

slip_ring_channels.basis: DECISION D-13: VIN+ VIN- (x2 each, 10 A), 22V+ 22V- (x2 each), USB 2.0 (4) -> 12 (see harness)

bearing.value: slewing ring / lazy-susan bearing, bore >= 60 mm for slip ring

topology.value: boost converter 12-17 V -> 22 V, synchronous, + high-side eFuse switch driven by EN/DIS_RFPA_VDD, + per-PA drain gating recommended
